notes.uncertainty: Each card quotes its standard error and a 95% interval of the statistic over the selected events; below N = 15 the interval is shown beside the SE, with the card's small-sample caveats.
notes.mae: Unweighted voxel MAE counts every hit equally. Per-hit energies span fifteen decades, so it is dominated by the lowest-energy hits, where the assignment is physically irrelevant.
notes.mae_energy_weighted: Energy-weighted MAE is the fraction of deposited energy the network mis-assigns between the two showers: the headline figure.
notes.clusters: The hits of one event share a shower, so the uncertainty treats events as clusters (linearised ratio of sums, Student-t).

model.title: Segmentation Model
model.caption: The segmentation network of the absolute (detector) frame assigns each hit's energy between the two showers, read from segmentation_absolute_pred against its truth E_A / E_voxel, which is fractional wherever both showers deposit in one cell. Classification uses the ≥ 0.5 majority on both sides; a cell shared by both showers is two rows, so unweighted counts see it twice. The headline is the energy-weighted MAE, exact over the selection: the fraction of deposited energy assigned to the wrong shower.

model.title: Incident Angle Estimation Model
model.caption: The angle network of the absolute (detector) frame predicts each shower's polar angle θ (angle_absolute_pred) against the incident θ; the azimuth φ is not predicted. θ does not wrap, so its mean residual is a meaningful bias. The headline is the θ resolution per shower, in mrad.
